top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks to Katori and Ye is a mature, independently reproduced achievement (JILA, RIKEN/Tokyo, NIST, PTB, SYRTE) with a decisive, well-defined contribution: magic-wavelength trapping of many atoms giving 10^-18 accuracy. It is a measurement-technique advance that opens a new window on gravitational redshift, drifting constants and dark matter. The two-name allocation is clean and the citation scope is precise. No award is clearly worse than this well-founded prize.
